# ezghcloud_database_logical_database (Resource)

A logical database inside a database, such as an app's own database. Destroying it drops its data.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (String) Database (dbi_) it lives in. Changing it replaces the logical database.
- `name` (String) Name in the engine: a lowercase letter, then up to 62 lowercase letters, digits and underscores. Changing it replaces the logical database.
- `project_id` (String) Project of the database. Changing it replaces the logical database.

### Read-Only

- `failure_code` (String) Why the logical database's last operation failed, as a code; null when it didn't.
- `failure_message` (String) Why the logical database's last operation failed; null when it didn't.
- `id` (String) database_id/name.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization managed by the configured provider.
- `status` (String) What the logical database is doing: creating, available, missing (absent from the engine, for example dropped in SQL), failed, and others while it changes.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Replace identifiers with values from your organization.
terraform import ezghcloud_database_logical_database.example 'ORGANIZATION_ID/PROJECT_ID/DATABASE_ID/NAME'
```
